FullColor.Warning.zh-CN: 实验功能：预览为固定视角模型预测，实盘全彩尚未验证。先使用同批盘片标定；本流程只生成文件。
FullColor.Warning.en: Experimental: previews predict a fixed-view model; physical full color is unverified. Calibrate with the same media batch first. This workflow only writes files.

FullColor.Empty.zh-CN: 在设计页排版后生成全彩预览。
FullColor.Empty.en: Arrange the design, then generate its Full Color preview.

FullColor.NeedProject.zh-CN: 先打开威宝 64099 的 BD 工程，并在设计页排版。
FullColor.NeedProject.en: Open a Verbatim 64099 BD project and arrange its design first.

FullColor.WrongDesign.zh-CN: 此计划与当前工程设计不匹配，请从当前设计重新生成。
FullColor.WrongDesign.en: This plan does not match the current design. Generate a plan from this project.

FullColor.UseForExport.zh-CN: 导出与刻录使用当前全彩结果
FullColor.UseForExport.en: Use the current Full Color result for export and burning

FullColor.ExportBeforeBurn.zh-CN: 请先导出当前设计的完整全彩 ISO，再在此刻录。设计或参数变化后必须重新生成并导出。
FullColor.ExportBeforeBurn.en: Export the current design's full Full Color ISO before burning. Regenerate and export after design or parameter changes.

FullColor.Capacity.zh-CN: 全彩镜像需要至少 12,219,392 个可写扇区，不能截短几何。
FullColor.Capacity.en: Full Color requires at least 12,219,392 writable sectors; geometry cannot be truncated.

FullColor.NoFiles.zh-CN: 当前全彩实验只支持纯绘图，请先在设计页清空随盘文件夹。
FullColor.NoFiles.en: This Full Color experiment supports drawing-only discs. Clear the disc-files folder in Design first.

FullColor.DesignInputHint.zh-CN: 转换整个可刻录环带，保留设计页布局、透明白底、亮度与 sRGB 设置；按 DIS 抖动规则分配模型纹理。中心孔和外圈不参与。
FullColor.DesignInputHint.en: Converts the complete recordable annulus, preserving design placement, white alpha, brightness and sRGB settings. DIS dither phases allocate model textures. The hub and outer margin are excluded.

FullColor.Current.zh-CN: 当前计划 · 模型预测，非实拍
FullColor.Current.en: Current plan · model prediction, not a photograph

FullColor.Stale.zh-CN: 尚无当前预览：图片或参数已改变，请重新生成。
FullColor.Stale.en: No current preview: the image or parameters changed. Generate a new preview.

FullColor.Residual.zh-CN: XYZ 残差：红色高 / 蓝色低，非 ΔE
FullColor.Residual.en: XYZ residual: red high / blue low, not Delta E

FullColor.Accept.zh-CN: 允许未实测模型导出实验镜像
FullColor.Accept.en: Allow an experimental image from the unmeasured model

FullColor.AcceptRequired.zh-CN: 请先检查预测图，并勾选“允许未实测模型导出实验镜像”。
FullColor.AcceptRequired.en: Inspect the prediction, then enable experimental export from the unmeasured model.

FullColor.OutputHint.zh-CN: 完整镜像 25.03 GB；导出后自动进行软件抽样校验。纯绘图扇区流，不含普通文件。请按镜像写入光盘。
FullColor.OutputHint.en: Full image: 25.03 GB. Export includes sampled software verification. Drawing-only sectors without ordinary files; write as a disc image.

FullColor.GeometryOnly.zh-CN: 当前支持威宝 64099：单层完整容量、恒定轨距。几何直接取 DIS 预设；光路坐标以盘心为原点，数据面朝观察者。
FullColor.GeometryOnly.en: Currently supports Verbatim 64099: single layer, full capacity, constant pitch. Geometry comes from the DIS preset. Optical coordinates use the disc center, with the data side facing the viewer.

FullColor.Measurements.zh-CN: 实测 XYZ 色表（可选）

FullColor.RuntimeHint.zh-CN: 需要 NumPy、Pillow、SciPy。首次预览自动构建模型色谱；后续复用缓存。
FullColor.RuntimeHint.en: Requires NumPy, Pillow and SciPy. The first preview builds synthetic spectra; later runs reuse the cache.

FullColor.InvalidNumber.zh-CN: 请输入有限数值，使用小数点。
FullColor.InvalidNumber.en: Enter a finite number using a decimal point.

FullColor.ReplaceHint.zh-CN: 新镜像完整生成后才替换已有文件。若文件正在被其他程序使用，关闭占用后可从断点完成发布。
FullColor.ReplaceHint.en: The existing image is replaced only after the new image is complete. If another application is using it, close that application and resume publication.

FullColor.ResumeHint.zh-CN: 发现断点记录。使用当前相同计划继续？未完成的 .partial 不能刻录。
FullColor.ResumeHint.en: A checkpoint exists. Resume with this same plan? Never burn an unfinished .partial file.

FullColor.CalibrationRegion.zh-CN: 标定窗口（仅用于 64 纹理计划）

FullColor.NativeDither.zh-CN: DIS 原生 BD 黑白抖动对照
FullColor.NativeDither.en: Native DIS BD monochrome dither reference

FullColor.TextureDots.zh-CN: 实际纹理点阵（伪彩色 ID，非颜色预测）
FullColor.TextureDots.en: Actual texture dots (false-color IDs, not predicted colors)
